senses.gloss:
गुच्छ गुच्छ, अस्, m. (assimilated form fr.
गुत्स), a bundle, a bunch, a bunch of flowers, a
cluster of blossoms, a clump (of grass &c.), a bunch
of peacock's feathers, the plumage of a peacock; a
pearl necklace of thirty-two or (according to others)
of seventy strings [cf. अर्ध-गुच्छ]; (ई), f. a
kind of Bonduc or Karañja.
—गुच्छ-कणिश, अस्,
m. a kind of corn, = रागिन्.
—गुच्छ-करञ्ज, अस्,
m. a kind of Karañja; [cf. गुच्छी.]
—गुच्छ-
दन्तिका, f. the plant Musa Sapientum, = कदली.
—गुच्छ-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the palm tree; [cf. ताल.]
—गुच्छ-पुष्प, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = सप्त-
च्छद; (ई), f., N. of two plants, Grislea Tomentosa
(धातकी), and another plant = शिमृडी.
—गुच्छ-
पुष्पक, अस्, m. two kinds of Karañja, the Rīṭhā-
karañja and the Guccha-karañja.
—गुच्छ-फल,
अस्, m., N. of several plants, = रीठा-करञ्ज; an-
other plant, Strychnos Potatorum [cf. कतक];
another plant, = राजादनी; (आ), f., N. of several
plants, Musa Sapientum, = कदली or the plantain;
the vine; the plant Solanum Indicum (काक-माची);
the plant Solanum Jacquini (अग्नि-दमनी); a kind
of leguminous plant, = निष्पावी.
—गुच्छ-बध्रा,
f., N. of a plant, Guṇḍālā.
—गुच्छ-मूलिका, f. N.
of a plant, = गुण्डासिनी.
—गुच्छार्ध (˚छ-अर्˚),
अस्, m. a pearl necklace of twenty-four strings; a
species of grass, Andropogon Schœnanthus.
—गुच्छा-
ह्व-कन्द (˚छ-आह्˚), अस्, m. a kind of esculent
root, = गुलञ्च-कन्द.

गुच्छक, अस्, m. a bunch, bundle, cluster of
blossoms, clump of grass, the plumage of a peacock,
a bunch of peacock's feathers; a pearl necklace of
thirty-two strings; a kind of Karañja, = रीठा-
करञ्ज; (अम्), n. a kind of fragrant plant, =
ग्रन्थि-पर्ण.

गुच्छाल, अस्, m. a species of grass, Andropogon
Schœnanthus.
